name: NatWest Group plc
research_rationale: Strong-buy screen fits cheapness and yield, but with no new results since Q3 IMS, impairment or tax overhang and BoE rate-risk press keep research at accumulate rather than full strong-buy conviction.

weekly_updates.summary:
30 Oct Q3 2026 IMS: attributable profit £1.5bn, RoTE 21.6%, total income +9.6% YTD; H1 income outlook reaffirmed, RWA ~£210bn at 1 Jan 2027 (Basel 3.1).  
Q3 impairment £277m (~2× prior-year quarter) and higher YTD tax (bank surcharge) drove a share fall despite operational strength.  
Quant screen still buy (4w, stable); timing accumulate, RSI ~29.

No news or new filings since the 30 Oct Q3 IMS refresh; thesis and risks unchanged.  
Quant screen remains buy (5w, stable); timing still accumulate, RSI ~29.  
No material change.

Quant screen upgraded to Strong Buy (1w, improving); timing still accumulate, RSI ~37.  
Since 1 Nov only routine share-buyback RNS (3 Nov); press rehashes Q3 NIM/loans and possible further BoE Bank Rate rises.  
30 Oct Q3 IMS thesis unchanged—elevated impairments and surcharge/tax still temper conviction.
